scope: Steam English retail FastFile catalog, source-available subset
proofBoundary: Every one of the 215 currently retrievable paths in the retained 297-path Steam English FastFile catalog was independently expanded and its raw top-level XAsset list structurally parsed.
For all 215 retrievable paths, the structural XAnimParts census closes exactly against the type-4 count in that zone's raw top-level XAsset list.
The 24114 XAnimParts and 22255 XModels are top-level per-zone population counts, not globally deduplicated unique asset identities; assets may be repeated or referenced across zones.
The 82 unavailable declared paths remain explicit blockers. No claim of complete English-retail population is made until their source bytes are available and audited.

XModel identity/source closure, global character classification, animation semantic coverage, material/texture/TechniqueSet/shader closure, and export-format fidelity are separate gates and remain unpromoted here.
This checkpoint does not redefine or replace the independent Stage18d 24855-XAnimParts scoped canary.
